bolt-beacon: Make a Spellcast Roll against a target within Far range. On a success, spend a Hope to send a bolt of shimmering light at them, dealing {{proficiency|#d8+2 magic damage|d8+2 magic damage using your Proficiency}}. The target becomes temporarily Vulnerable and glows brightly until the condition is cleared.
mending-touch:
Lay your hands on a creature and channel healing magic. When you can take a few minutes to focus on the target, spend 2 Hope to clear a Hit Point or a Stress on them.
Once per long rest, when you spend this time learning something new about them or revealing something about yourself, clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on them instead.
reassurance: Once per rest, after an ally attempts an action roll but before consequences take place, offer assistance or words of support; your ally can reroll their dice.
final-words: Infuse a corpse with a moment of life to speak with it. Make a Spellcast Roll (13). On a success with Hope, the corpse answers up to three questions; with Fear, one. It answers truthfully but can’t impart what it didn’t know in life. On a failure, or once it has finished answering, the body turns to dust.
healing-hands: Make a Spellcast Roll (13) and target a creature other than yourself within Melee range. On a success, mark a Stress to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress on the target. On a failure, mark a Stress to clear a Hit Point or a Stress instead. You can’t heal the same target again until your next long rest.
second-wind: Once per rest, when you succeed on an attack against an adversary, clear 3 Stress or a Hit Point. On a success with Hope, also clear 3 Stress or a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.
voice-of-reason:
Gain advantage on action rolls to de-escalate violent situations or convince someone to follow your lead.
When all your Stress slots are marked, gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for damage rolls.
divination: Once per long rest, spend 3 Hope to reach out to the forces beyond and ask one “yes or no” question about an event, person, place, or situation in the near future. The present falls away and you see the answer.
life-ward:
Spend 3 Hope and choose an ally within Close range to mark with a glowing sigil of protection. When they would make a death move, they clear a Hit Point instead.
The effect ends when it saves them from a death move, you cast Life Ward on another target, or you take a long rest.
shape-material: Spend a Hope to shape a section of natural material you’re touching (such as stone, ice, or wood) no larger than you to suit your purpose, such as forming a rudimentary tool or a door. You can only affect material within Close range of where you touch it.
smite: Once per rest, spend 3 Hope to charge your smite. When you next successfully attack with a weapon, double your damage roll result. This attack deals magic damage regardless of the weapon’s damage type.
restoration:
After a long rest, place {{spellcast|# tokens|tokens equal to your Spellcast trait}} on this card. Touch a creature and spend any number of tokens to clear 2 Hit Points or 2 Stress per token spent.
You can also spend a token when touching a creature to clear the Vulnerable condition or heal a physical or magical ailment (the GM might require more tokens for stronger ailments).
When you take a long rest, clear unspent tokens.
zone-of-protection: Make a Spellcast Roll (16). Once per long rest on a success, choose a point within Far range and create a visible zone of protection there for all allies within Very Close range of it, placing a d6 on this card with the 1 facing up. When an ally in the zone takes damage, they reduce it by the die’s value, then increase the die’s value by one. When it would exceed 6, the effect ends.
healing-strike: When you deal damage to an adversary, spend 2 Hope to clear a Hit Point on an ally within Close range.
splendor-touched:
When 4 or more loadout cards are from the Splendor domain, gain:
- +3 bonus to your Severe damage threshold
- Once per long rest, when incoming damage would make you mark Hit Points, mark that much Stress or spend that much Hope instead.
shield-aura:
Mark a Stress to cast a protective aura on a target within Very Close range. When the target marks an Armor Slot, they reduce the attack’s severity by an additional threshold. If this causes a creature who would be damaged to mark no Hit Points, the effect ends.
You can hold Shield Aura on only one creature at a time.
stunning-sunlight: Make a Spellcast Roll to unleash burning sunlight on all adversaries in front of you within Far range. On a success, spend any number of Hope to force that many targets you succeeded against to make a Reaction Roll (14). Those who succeed take 3d20+3 magic damage; those who fail take 4d20+5 magic damage and are temporarily Stunned. While Stunned, they can’t use reactions or take other actions until they clear the condition.
overwhelming-aura:
Make a Spellcast Roll (15) to empower your aura. On a success, spend 2 Hope to make your Presence {{spellcast|#|equal to your Spellcast trait}} until your next long rest.
While active, an adversary must mark a Stress when they target you with an attack.
salvation-beam: Make a Spellcast Roll (16). On a success, mark any number of Stress to target a line of allies within Far range. Clear Hit Points on them equal to the Stress marked, divided among them as you like.
invigoration: When you or an ally within Close range has used a feature with an exhaustion limit (such as once per rest or once per session), spend any number of Hope and roll that many d6s. If any roll a 6, the feature can be used again.
resurrection:
Make a Spellcast Roll (20). On a success, restore a creature dead no longer than 100 years to full strength, then roll a d6; on a 5 or lower, place this card in your vault permanently.
On a failure, you can’t cast Resurrection again for a week.
